notes:
Shopify store (Cloudflare-fronted). Direct requests began returning HTTP 429 with 'Cf-Mitigated: challenge' after ~10 page fetches; all listing pages were then read through the Google translate.goog proxy (https://www-milton-in.translate.goog/?_x_tr_sl=en&_x_tr_tl=es&_x_tr_hl=en), which returns the origin's genuine server-rendered HTML. Canonical origin URLs are recorded as 'link'. IMPORTANT: Shopify's /collections.json 'products_count' is NOT usable on this store - it is far higher than the live listing (e.g. glass-tumblers products_count=79 vs 23 shown; melamine-dinner-set products_count=13 but the storefront says 'Sorry, there are no products in this collection'). Every qty below comes from the storefront's own

header. That element was cross-checked by paginating five collections to the very end and counting unique product card IDs - tableware 78=78, opalware 59=59, jugs-tumblers 49=49, bakeware-serveware 29=29, opalware-cup-saucer-set 25=25, glass-tumblers 23=23 - an exact match in every case. Milton is a functional housewares brand: the Bottles & Flasks, Lunchboxes, Casseroles, Cookware, Storage (non-glass), Home Essentials (buckets/dustbins), Cleaning, Appliances, Spare Parts and Gifting branches of the mega-menu were all excluded per spec. Also dropped: 'Carafes, Flask & Dispensers' (6 of its 7 products are thermosteel flasks, only 1 is a carafe), 'Glass Bakeware & Casseroles' (bakeware/casserole), 'Insulated Jugs' and 'Thermosteel Water Jugs' (vacuum-flask products), 'Oil Dispenser' (kitchen utility), and 'Melamine Dinner Set' (0 products live). Glass Bottles, Glass Jars and Fridge Glass Containers are included on the 'ALL glassware' rule (glass bottles / jars / containers are named in the spec) even though their parent menus are excluded. The site has no decor/lighting range beyond the single Diyas collection; no rows were padded.
